svg.title: OpenSCAD Keyboard, Mouse & Code Modifier Cheat Sheet
svg.desc: Printable keyboard shortcuts reference for OpenSCAD 2021.01 and separately labeled development-snapshot shortcuts. Organized by building and exporting, camera views, editor actions, menus and mouse controls. Check the associated versioned guide before relying on a shortcut.
svg.text: Default shortcuts from OpenSCAD's own menu definitions: release 2021.01 and current development snapshots (verified 2026-11-14)
macOS: Ctrl means Cmd (⌘); laptop F-keys may need Fn. Shortcuts are shared by both versions unless marked.
PNWC ULTIMATE CYBERSECURITY MASTER GUIDE · CAD/OpenSCAD · Most-used loop: edit → F5 preview → fix → F6 render → F7 export
